title: Corrective fix for B-d7c0d824-review: Review Test suite: core CRUD and infrastructure tests
description:
Blocked reason: docs/memory/conventions.md:39 documents `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/` as the run command, but system Python lacks numpy/sqlite-vec and will produce ImportError rather than test results. The correct invocation is `.venv/bin/pytest` (or `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/`). This misleads operators into thinking tests are broken when the environment is simply wrong.

Remaining work: Fix conventions.md run command to reference the venv Python (`.venv/bin/pytest` or equivalent) and add a note that system Python is insufficient due to missing numpy/sqlite-vec dependencies.
